Messages.Author: Luis P. Duarte
Messages.Body:
1. Can the same reacting minion play twice a Telepatic Counter
on the same action, to reduce a bleed on 2+2, for example?

2. And can a vampire block a bleed and if unsucessful (block)
can the same vampire deflect it?

3. Can a vampire deflect a bleed after a bleed action modifier
has been played? Or it can only be deflected after the
bleed action is announced AND before action modifiers
played?

4. Can another minion try to block an action after the first have
failed?

Thanks!
.- Luis....@ip.pt

Messages.Author: Chris Berger
Messages.Body:
Luis P. Duarte wrote:
>
> 1. Can the same reacting minion play twice a Telepatic Counter
> on the same action, to reduce a bleed on 2+2, for example?
>

No. Telepathic Counter is a reaction. Only 1 of a given reaction (or
action modifier) may be played per minion per action.

> 2. And can a vampire block a bleed and if unsucessful (block)
> can the same vampire deflect it?
>

A vampire cannot block and be unsuccessful. However, if a vampire
attempts to block a bleed, he may of course (assuming he's untapped or
has played a Wake) play a reaction card to deflect the bleed. Note: if
a vampire uses Telepathic Misdirection for +1 intercept, but is still
unsuccessful, he may not use Telepathic Misdirection to bounce the
bleed, because it is a reaction. Another vampire could, however.

> 3. Can a vampire deflect a bleed after a bleed action modifier
> has been played? Or it can only be deflected after the
> bleed action is announced AND before action modifiers
> played?
>

Deflect it when you want to. Generally, once you've determined that the
bleed will not be blocked, the methuselah who's been bled asks "how
much?" If the predator modifies the bleed, then you can deflect it. Or
if he says he won't modify it, you can still deflect it.

> 4. Can another minion try to block an action after the first have
> failed?
>

Yes.

-Chris

Messages.Author: Dhar...@yahoo.com
Messages.Body:
"Luis P. Duarte" <Luis....@ip.pt> wrote:
> 1. Can the same reacting minion play twice a Telepatic Counter
> on the same action, to reduce a bleed on 2+2, for example?

Uh....no. No minion may play duplicates of the same reaction card
during an action. If you want to use 2 Telepathic Counters during
a bleed, you need two ready, untapped vampires with Auspex.

> 2. And can a vampire block a bleed and if unsucessful (block)
> can the same vampire deflect it?

Absolutely.

> 3. Can a vampire deflect a bleed after a bleed action modifier
> has been played? Or it can only be deflected after the
> bleed action is announced AND before action modifiers
> played?

Yep. A decline to block does not infer a decline to react.

> 4. Can another minion try to block an action after the first have
> failed?

Absolutely.

Noal McDonald
